prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 7 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Image 1: the character sheet of Lu Shaoze (28), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of Ji Ran (27), look S3
Image 3: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people

Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop black handbag; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Ran stands beneath the autumn landscape painting on the elevator side of the console table, holding the black handbag, facing Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze stands beneath the painting on the front-door side, facing her and the elevator doors, his grin stiff. The elevator doors are closed. Camera on the corridor side, facing the painting.
Panel 1: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end on the elevator side, facing Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze recovers his smirk, slides a hand into his trouser pocket and leans toward Ji Ran.
Panel 2: Close-up insert, slight high angle, locked-off camera, from the corridor end. Ji Ran's fingers tighten hard around the handle of the black handbag, her knuckles going pale.
Panel 3: Close-up, clean single on Ji Ran's face, slow push in, eye level, from the corridor end on the front-door side. Ji Ran's eyes redden and glisten. She presses her lips together and holds her anger in.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end on the front-door side, facing Ji Ran. Ji Ran lifts her chin and stares straight at Lu Shaoze.
Panel 5: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Lu Shaoze's shoulder, from the corridor end on the front-door side, facing Ji Ran. Ji Ran takes one step toward Lu Shaoze and gives a bitter half smile.
Panel 6: Medium shot, clean single on Lu Shaoze, locked-off camera, eye level, from the corridor end on the elevator side. Lu Shaoze's smirk falters and he narrows his eyes.
Panel 7: Medium close-up, slight low angle, locked-off camera, from the corridor end on the front-door side, facing Ji Ran. Ji Ran tosses her hair back and looks at Lu Shaoze with calm defiance, the black handbag on her arm.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
